name: Specimen Floater D
summary: Twenty-five lakh cover. No room cap, no sub-limits, one large deductible.
shape: There is no room rent cap and no procedure sub-limit at all, so a single large deductible is the only thing standing between the bill and the Sum Insured.

provenance.sourceQuote: Sum Insured: Rupees Twenty-Five Lakh (Rs. 25,00,000) for the Policy Year, available on a floater basis to all Insured Persons named in the Schedule.
items of personal comfort and convenience, toiletries, attendant charges, admission and registration fees, documentation and service charges, and other non-medical items
A deductible of Rupees One Lakh (Rs. 1,00,000) shall be borne by the Insured Person in respect of each and every claim
No claim is admissible for any Illness contracted within thirty days of the commencement of the first Policy Year
Cataract surgery and hernia repair are subject to a waiting period of twenty-four months of Continuous Cover
A condition pre-existing at the commencement of the first Policy Year is subject to a waiting period of thirty-six months of Continuous Cover
The Company shall not be liable for any expense in respect of the following at any time during the currency of this Policy
After sixty months of Continuous Cover, no claim under this Policy shall be contestable on the ground of non-disclosure or misrepresentation
